Accept both lighting-color corrections and the recurring callback rename. Direction accumulation targets the diffuse auxiliary; one selected source supplies attenuated RGB to the separate specular auxiliary. Table registration disproves a setup-only interpretation.

Accept the two-shared-latch and overlay-pointer correction. Preserve the exceptional state-4 lifetime branch and defer its reachability/safety to the lifecycle owner; neither same-joint synchronization nor null-safe cleanup is established.
